title: The server stopped sending metrics
summary: No metrics from the server for 10 minutes: it's down or unreachable, or Alloy stopped (sudo systemctl status alloy).

title: Fans can't reach the app
summary: For 3 minutes, none of Grafana's probes outside the server got a healthy answer from /api/health: DNS, Caddy, the certificate or the firewall, or the app itself (the other alerts say if it's inside). Grafana's Synthetics page shows each probe's error.

title: The uptime check stopped reporting
summary: No results from the uptime check for 20 minutes, so "Fans can't reach the app" can't fire: Synthetic Monitoring isn't switched on, the check was disabled or removed, or the free tier's checks ran out. Run deploy/grafana/apply-alerts.sh (README.md, "Alerts").

title: The server checks stopped running
summary: server-check.sh last ran {{ humanizeDuration $values.A.Value }} ago (sudo systemctl status sports-follow-check.timer).

title: A disk is filling up
summary: Disk {{ $labels.mountpoint }} is {{ printf "%.0f" $values.A.Value }}% full (sudo du -xh --max-depth=1 {{ $labels.mountpoint }} | sort -h).

title: Memory is short
summary: Tasks spent {{ printf "%.0f" $values.A.Value }}% of the last 5 minutes waiting for memory (free -m; docker stats --no-stream).

title: Free memory is almost gone
summary: Only {{ printf "%.1f" $values.A.Value }}% of memory is free (free -m; docker stats --no-stream).

title: The out-of-memory killer stopped a process
summary: {{ printf "%.0f" $values.A.Value }} process(es) stopped for lack of memory in the last 10 minutes (sudo journalctl -k | grep -i oom).

title: AWS is holding back the server's CPU
summary: {{ printf "%.0f" $values.A.Value }}% of CPU time is being withheld: Lightsail's burst allowance is used up. If it lasts, move to a bigger plan.

title: The database backup is late
summary: {{ if gt $values.A.Value 1e9 }}There is no database dump at all{{ else }}The newest database dump is {{ humanizeDuration $values.A.Value }} old{{ end }} (docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml logs backup).

title: Off-site backups aren't working
summary: {{ if gt $values.A.Value 1e9 }}Off-site backups haven't worked once since they were set up{{ else }}Off-site backups last worked {{ humanizeDuration $values.A.Value }} ago{{ end }} (sudo journalctl -u sports-follow-offsite).

title: Docker isn't answering
summary: Docker didn't answer the server checks, so the app is likely down (sudo systemctl status docker).

title: An app container is down
summary: {{ $labels.service }} isn't running, or is unhealthy (docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml ps; logs {{ $labels.service }}).

title: A container keeps restarting
summary: {{ $labels.service }} restarted {{ printf "%.0f" $values.A.Value }} times in the last hour (docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml logs {{ $labels.service }}).

title: No trusted HTTPS certificate
summary: Phones won't trust the certificate Caddy serves (docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml logs caddy).

title: The HTTPS certificate hasn't renewed
summary: The certificate expires in {{ humanizeDuration $values.A.Value }} and Caddy hasn't renewed it (docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml logs caddy).
